title: Answer: consciousness is the brain’s model of its attention, and the beliefs drawn from it

statements.text: Consciousness, as people claim it, is the brain's simplified model of its own attention together with the beliefs higher cognition draws from that model. AST is a theory of attention, of the in-the-moment feature called experience, and of those beliefs.

sources.locator: A Theory of Consciousness that Embodies Principles 1 and 2
sources.quote: AST is therefore a theory of attention, a theory of the in-the-moment feature we call experience, and a theory of the more abstract, cognitive beliefs that people develop as a result.
